name: OpenBoardView
description:
OpenBoardView is an open-source electronics schematic and printed circuit board (.brd / .cad) file viewer. Tailored for hardware repair technicians and electronics engineers, it visualizes board layouts and component pinouts.

Features:
- Supports major boardview formats including BRD, BDV, CAD, CST, GR, and FZ
- Interactive searching for components, pins, nets, and test points
- Pinout inspection with visual highlight of connected circuit nets
- Mirror, rotate, flip, and zoom controls for matching physical boards
- Lightweight, fast, and cross-platform architecture with minimal resource usage
